edits.before: No new ult — press the early lead; scaling supports are waking up behind you.
edits.after: His R Static Field plus a Q-E chain one-shots you at this HP, and your Focused Resolve root is too slow to beat the instant grab.

edits.before: First item: RQ chunks and RE engages — convert to plates and picks now.
edits.after: His one-shot hook threat peaks with first item — one Rocket Grab into Power Fist and Static Field kills a squishy, so play permanently behind minions.

edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: Static Field silences on activation, so save Mantra-E to react after his R lands, not before — a pre-cast shield wastes the charge.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: Power Fist's wind-up is the tell — step back on the animation, not the hit; waiting for the knockup itself is already too late.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. It writes your spacing rules. - RE shield-speed is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab (Q) is 20/19/18/17/16s — a whiff is a long window to punish. Stay behind minions until it's down. - R Static Field (60/40/20s) silences on activation, killing your escape — hold Mantra-E to react, don't pre-cast it. - Power Fist (E) has a visible wind-up before the knockup; that's your step-back cue.
